init.custom:
--== HASTE STUFF ==--

local _dumped_quiver_mapping = {
    [1.15] = {18714,19320,19319,29118,34106,29118,29143,29144,34100,34099},
    [1.14] = {2663,2662},
    [1.13] = {7372,7371},
    [1.12] = {8218,8217},
    [1.11] = {3604,3605},
    [1.10] = {2101,5439,7278,11362,11362,3574,5441,7279,11363,2102,11362},
}
aura_env.quivers = {}
for haste, quivers in pairs(_dumped_quiver_mapping) do
    for _, quiver in ipairs(quivers) do
        aura_env.quivers[quiver] = haste
    end
end

aura_env.haste = function()
    local haste = 1 + GetRangedHaste() / 100
    for i=1,4 do
        local bag_name = C_Container.GetBagName(i)
        
        if bag_name ~= nil then
            local bag_id = GetItemInfoInstant(bag_name)
            if aura_env.quivers[bag_id] ~= nil then
                return haste * aura_env.quivers[bag_id]
            end
        end
    end
    
    return haste
end

--== SPELL INFO ==--

aura_env.spells = {
    aimed = GetSpellInfo(19434),
    multi = GetSpellInfo(2643),
    auto = GetSpellInfo(75),
}
aura_env.spell_names = {}
for _, name in pairs(aura_env.spells) do
    tinsert(aura_env.spell_names, name)
end

--== on spell cast ==--

aura_env.casting = false
aura_env.spell_name = "none"
aura_env.spell_start = function(spell_name)
    if tContains(aura_env.spell_names, spell_name) then
        if spell_name == aura_env.spells.auto and aura_env.config.show_auto_cast == false then
            return false
        end
        
        aura_env.pushback_total = 0
        aura_env.push = 0
        aura_env.push_number = 0
        
        local _, _, spell_icon, cast_time, _, _, spell_id = GetSpellInfo(spell_name)
        
        aura_env.spell_name = spell_name
        aura_env.spell_icon = spell_icon
        aura_env.cast_time = max(cast_time, 500) -- MS, not S
        aura_env.casting = true
        
        if aura_env.spell_name == aura_env.spells["aimed"] then
            aura_env.cast_time = 3500 -- i fucking hate classic
        end
        
        aura_env.duration = aura_env.cast_time / 1000 / aura_env.haste()
        aura_env.expiration_time = aura_env.duration + GetTime()
        
        return true
    end
end

--== on damage taken ==--

aura_env.expiration_time = GetTime()
aura_env.pushback = false
aura_env.push_backs = {1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2}
aura_env.push_number = 0
aura_env.add_push_back = function()
    aura_env.push_number = min(aura_env.push_number + 1, 5)
    
    if (aura_env.duration - (aura_env.expiration_time - GetTime())) < aura_env.push_backs[aura_env.push_number] then
        aura_env.pushback_total = aura_env.pushback_total + (aura_env.duration - (aura_env.expiration_time - GetTime()))
        aura_env.push = aura_env.duration - (aura_env.expiration_time - GetTime())
    else
        aura_env.push = aura_env.push_backs[aura_env.push_number]
        aura_env.pushback_total = aura_env.pushback_total + aura_env.push_backs[aura_env.push_number]
    end
    aura_env.pushback = true
    
    aura_env.expiration_time = aura_env.expiration_time + aura_env.push
    return aura_env.casting
end

function(event, _, cleu, _, _, source_name, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, spell_name, _, fail_type)
    if source_name == UnitName("player") and spell_name == aura_env.spell_name then
        if cleu == "SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS" or (cleu == "SPELL_CAST_FAILED" and fail_type ~= getglobal("SPELL_FAILED_SPELL_IN_PROGRESS")) then
            aura_env.spell_name = nil
            aura_env.casting = nil
            return true
        end
    end
    
    if aura_env.expiration_time - GetTime() <= 0 then -- Fixes bar being stuck because SPELL_CAST_FAILED is not always fired
        aura_env.spell_name = nil
        aura_env.casting = nil
        return true
    end
end

If you want a sound to play when you enter a certain range please follow these instructions.

Melee Range: 

Press on the Conditions tab, go to the bottom of Condition 3 and press "Add Property Change"

This will make a new box come up, that says "and" above it. Select these options

Sound  -  Play  -  *Sound of your choice*  - Master

For all other ranges use the exact same method just using a different condition instead of "Condition 3".

Dead Zone = Condition 5

Sweet Spot = Condition 6

You can find the rest by looking at the conditions colour.

From testing this appears to work with any of the ranges.

trigger.custom:
function(a, e, ...)
    local currentMana = UnitPower("player", 0)
    local fsrDuration = 5

    if e == "COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED" then
        -- attributable mana gain (Mana Spring, Water Shield, potions...):
        -- remember it so it doesn't count as the global regen tick.
        -- "Drink" is deliberately NOT filtered: drink ticks driving the spark
        -- is intended (drink-walking reads the sip timing off this spark)
        local destGUID = select(8, ...)
        local spellName = select(13, ...)
        local amount = select(15, ...)
        if spellName ~= "Drink" and destGUID == UnitGUID("player") and type(amount) == "number" then
            local now = GetTime()
            if aura_env.energizeTime ~= now then
                aura_env.energizeTime = now
                aura_env.energizeAmount = 0
            end
            aura_env.energizeAmount = aura_env.energizeAmount + amount
        end
        return false
    end

    if currentMana >= UnitPowerMax("player", 0) then
        return false
    end

    if e == "UNIT_POWER_FREQUENT" and currentMana > aura_env.lastMana then
        local gained = currentMana - aura_env.lastMana
        local energized = 0
        if aura_env.energizeTime and GetTime() - aura_env.energizeTime < 0.25 then
            energized = aura_env.energizeAmount or 0
        end
        aura_env.energizeAmount = math.max(0, energized - gained)
        -- only a gain beyond recent energizes is the global 2s regen tick;
        -- ignore ticks inside the FSR (Meditation-style partial regen)
        if gained > energized and GetTime() >= aura_env.lastCast + fsrDuration then
            local duration = 2
            a[""] = {
                show = true,
                changed = true,
                duration = duration,
                expirationTime = GetTime() + duration,
                progressType = "timed",
                autoHide = true
            }
        end
        aura_env.lastMana = currentMana
    elseif e == "UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED" and currentMana < aura_env.lastMana then
        local duration = fsrDuration
        a[""] = {
            show = true,
            changed = true,
            duration = duration,
            expirationTime = GetTime() + duration,
            progressType = "timed",
            autoHide = true
        }
        aura_env.lastMana = currentMana
        aura_env.lastCast = GetTime()
    end
    return true
end
